haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works and reaches the same account. Lookup matches on the Google sub only, email is ignored for linked accounts, and users.email is never overwritten from Google.
haiku-low.q2: The email must be verified. The user must then enter the existing account's password on the confirm page, which must pass bcrypt, before the identity is linked and a session starts.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds one to failed_logins. The 5th sets locked_until to now plus 15 minutes, resets the counter, and drops the ticket, so Google sign-in must be restarted after the lock.
haiku-low.q4: An unmatched verified email creates a new user with NULL password_hash, email_verified_at set, and an identity row, in one transaction, then starts a session. Unverified email is refused with an email+password message and nothing is created.
haiku-low.q5: Both fail. At 12 minutes the 10-minute attempt has expired, and a repeated callback finds the row already removed by GETDEL. Either way the user sees the sign-in expired or invalid, try again page.
haiku-low.q6: It creates a new session: kills any old sid session, inserts a sessions row, and sets an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax sid cookie for 14 days, slid on use. The existing sid cookie is replaced.
haiku-low.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. If the Google sub belongs to another user, it is refused with a message that the account is linked to another account.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:<state>, with a 10-minute TTL. The callback removes it with GETDEL as its first step, or it expires.
haiku-low.q9: Redis key oidc:pending:<id> holds user_id, google_sub, google_email and next, with a 10-minute TTL. The browser holds only the id in an HttpOnly, Secure pending_link cookie. It is deleted on success, or dropped when locked or expired.
haiku-low.q10: In Postgres table user_identities. UNIQUE(provider, subject) allows one user per Google account, and UNIQUE(user_id, provider) allows one Google identity per user.
haiku-low.q11: The user sees the Google sign-in failed, try again message on /login. There is no retry, because codes are single-use and the attempt row is already gone.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt record stores mode (login or link) and, for link, user_id, and the callback branches on mode. For link, it checks the signed-in session user equals the attempt's user_id, else shows the same error page.

sonnet.q1: They still get their same account: matching is only on sub (email is only checked when the sub isn't linked), and users.email is never overwritten from Google.
sonnet.q2: The half-link: they must confirm via the confirm page by entering the existing account's password (bcrypt check). Only on the right password is the identity inserted and start_session run. Wrong passwords/lock/expired ticket block it.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and shows the form again. The 5th sets locked_until = now + 15 min, resets the counter, and drops the ticket (and they must restart Google sign-in after the lock). If already locked, ticket is dropped, cookie cleared, 'Account temporarily locked'. No identity is created.
sonnet.q4: Verified email matching no user: one transaction creates a users row (NULL password_hash, email_verified_at = now) plus the identity row, then start_session. Unverified email with unknown sub: refused, told to use email+password, nothing created.
sonnet.q5: Both cases: the attempt record is gone (expired after 10 min TTL, or already consumed by GETDEL), so the user sees the 'sign-in expired or invalid, try again' page. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q6: start_session: kills any old sid session, inserts a new sessions row, sets the sid cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax) for 14 days slid forward on use, then redirects to next if a relative on-site path, otherwise /home.
sonnet.q7: Neither: no password prompt and the Google email need not match. If the sub is already linked to another user, it is refused with 'this Google account is linked to another account' (if linked to this user: 'already linked').
sonnet.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:<state> (with mode, user_id for link, nonce, code_verifier, next), 10 min TTL. The callback's GETDEL removes it atomically first thing; unused ones expire.
sonnet.q9: In Redis at oidc:pending:<id> (user_id, google_sub, google_email, next), 10 min TTL. The browser holds only the id in the pending_link cookie (HttpOnly, Secure). Deleted on successful confirm, on lockout or already-locked (cookie cleared too), or by TTL expiry.
sonnet.q10: In the Postgres user_identities table (user_id, provider='google', subject=sub, email_at_link, linked_at). UNIQUE(provider, subject) gives one user per Google account; UNIQUE(user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: The user is sent to /login with 'Google sign-in failed, try again'. No retry, since codes are single-use and the attempt row is already gone. Covers Google 5xx/timeouts too.
sonnet.q12: The mode (login/link) stored in the Redis attempt record. For link, the attempt stores user_id and the callback checks the signed-in session's user equals it, else shows the same expired/invalid error page; only then it inserts the identity.
